description: Gzipped size cap in bytes for each package entry. Each cap is the measured size plus 10 percent, rounded up to the next 10 bytes. npm run check:size fails when an entry is over its cap or has no cap. A proposal is the figure in the amendment 1 spec, kept for comparison. The measuredGzipped value of each row is the size its cap was derived from: the G0 baseline for the entries that existed at G0, the G1 measure after review round 1 for /frame and /values, and the G2 measure for /curves and /linear. The sizes are in docs/baseline.md, sections G1 build and G2 build. The entries under proposedForNewEntries do not exist yet and are not checked.
measuredWith: esbuild 0.28.2, bundle, minify, esm, React external, then gzip. See docs/baseline.md, sections G0 and G1 build.
